# Links between files

*Generated by `tools/build_index.py`. “See” links come from the `→ See:` lines at the foot of a file. “Text” links are any other mention of a file id (C-24, Document 2.49, a backticked path) in the body. Ids written another way (“the Hallvik report”) are not caught.*

**328 files, 755 See links, 1317 further text links.**

A `→ See:` line names an id or path that matches no file. Most are typos, renamed files, or files that do not exist yet.
